```{r Step 1: Setup and load required packages}
# Set knitting options for clean output
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo    = TRUE,    # show code
  message = FALSE,   # suppress messages
  warning = FALSE    # suppress warnings
)


# Load required packages and define input/output folders
library(tidyverse)
library(httr)
library(rvest)
library(git2r)
library(paperboy)
library(lubridate)
library(jsonlite)
library(purrr)

# Define output folders
step_1_working_data_output_folder <- "/Users/zorbeyozcan/newsmedia_scraper/working_data/urlset_scraper_output"
step_1_output_folder <- "/Users/zorbeyozcan/newsmedia_scraper/data"
step_1_logging_folder <- "/Users/zorbeyozcan/newsmedia_scraper/documentation"

# Check if folders exist and create if necessary
step_1_folder_check <- c(step_1_working_data_output_folder, 
                         step_1_output_folder, 
                         step_1_logging_folder)

for(folder in step_1_folder_check){
  if(!dir.exists(folder)){
    dir.create(folder, recursive = TRUE)
  }
}

# Load link list 
step_1_link_list <- readRDS(file.path(step_1_output_folder, "all_links_filtered_by_date.rds"))

# Load paywall domain input with sample articles
step_1_paywall_input <- read_csv(file.path(step_1_output_folder, "paywall_domains.csv"))

# Verify data loaded correctly
step_1_links_loaded <- nrow(step_1_link_list)
step_1_paywall_domains_loaded <- length(unique(step_1_paywall_input$domain))


cat(sprintf("Step 1 completed: Packages loaded, output folders defined. Loaded %d links and %d paywall domains.\n", 
            step_1_links_loaded,
```

```{r}
# Load and analyze paywall markers from input CSV
step_2_paywall_data <- step_1_paywall_input

# Initialize dataframe to store paywall rules per domain
step_2_paywall_rules_df <- data.frame(
  domain = character(),
  has_paywall = logical(),
  markers = character(),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

# Process each unique domain
step_2_unique_domains <- unique(step_2_paywall_data$domain)

for(domain in step_2_unique_domains){
  # Get all rows for this domain
  step_2_domain_subset <- step_2_paywall_data %>%
    filter(domain == !!domain)
  
  # Check if any paywall_url contains "no_paywall"
  step_2_no_paywall_check <- any(grepl("no_paywall", step_2_domain_subset$paywall_url, ignore.case = TRUE))
  
  if(step_2_no_paywall_check){
    # Domain has no paywall
    step_2_paywall_rules_df <- rbind(step_2_paywall_rules_df,
                                      data.frame(domain = domain,
                                                has_paywall = FALSE,
                                                markers = NA,
                                                stringsAsFactors = FALSE))
  } else {
    # Domain potentially has paywall - extract possible markers
    step_2_markers <- step_2_domain_subset$possible_markers %>%
      na.omit() %>%
      unique() %>%
      paste(collapse = "/")
    
    step_2_paywall_rules_df <- rbind(step_2_paywall_rules_df,
                                      data.frame(domain = domain,
                                                has_paywall = TRUE,
                                                markers = step_2_markers,
                                                stringsAsFactors = FALSE))
  }
}

# Save paywall rules for later use
write_csv(step_2_paywall_rules_df, 
          file.path(step_1_working_data_output_folder, "paywall_rules.csv"))

# Create function to check paywall status (to be expanded later)
step_2_check_paywall_func <- function(domain, html_content = NULL){
  # Check if domain exists in rules
  step_2_domain_rule <- step_2_paywall_rules_df %>%
    filter(domain == !!domain)
  
  if(nrow(step_2_domain_rule) == 0){
    # Domain not in paywall rules - return NA
    return(NA)
  }
  
  if(!step_2_domain_rule$has_paywall[1]){
    # Domain has no paywall
    return(FALSE)
  }
  
  # TODO: Add HTML content analysis for paywall markers
  # This will be implemented when the CSV is complete
  return(NA)
}

cat(sprintf("Step 2 completed: Paywall rules initialized for %d domains. %d domains marked as no-paywall.\n",
            nrow(step_2_paywall_rules_df),
            sum(!step_2_paywall_rules_df$has_paywall)))
```

```{r}
## Step 3: Clone repository and create pb_deliver_advanced

# Clone paperboy repository
step_3_repo_url <- "https://github.com/JBGruber/paperboy.git"
step_3_temp_dir <- file.path(step_1_working_data_output_folder, "paperboy_repo")

if(!dir.exists(step_3_temp_dir)){
  step_3_repo <- clone(step_3_repo_url, step_3_temp_dir)
} else {
  step_3_repo <- repository(step_3_temp_dir)
  pull(step_3_repo)
}

# Load all necessary R files from paperboy
step_3_all_r_files <- list.files(file.path(step_3_temp_dir, "R"), 
                                pattern = "\\.R$", 
                                full.names = TRUE)

# Remove test files
step_3_all_r_files <- step_3_all_r_files[!grepl("test|zzz", step_3_all_r_files)]

# Source all files to get complete functionality
invisible(lapply(step_3_all_r_files, source))

# Create required environments if missing
if(!exists("paperboy.env")) {
  paperboy.env <- new.env()
  paperboy.env$ua <- "paperboy R package (https://github.com/JBGruber/paperboy)"
}

if(!exists("inform_now_env")) {
  inform_now_env <- new.env()
}

# Override pb_tick to avoid progress bar issues
pb_tick <- function(x, verbose, pb) {
  if(!is.null(verbose) && verbose && !is.null(pb)) {
    tryCatch({
      cli::cli_progress_update(id = pb)
    }, error = function(e) {
      # Silently ignore progress bar errors
    })
  }
  return(invisible(NULL))
}

# Helper operator for NULL default values
`%||%` <- function(x, y) if (is.null(x)) y else x

# Domain extraction helper function
step_3_extract_domain <- function(urls) {
  domains <- character(length(urls))
  for (i in seq_along(urls)) {
    url <- urls[i]
    domain <- gsub("^https?://", "", url)
    domain <- gsub("^www\\.", "", domain)
    domain <- strsplit(domain, "/")[[1]][1]
    domains[i] <- domain
  }
  return(domains)
}

# Create pb_deliver_advanced
pb_deliver_advanced <- function(x, 
                               try_default = TRUE, 
                               ignore_fails = FALSE, 
                               verbose = NULL, 
                               httr_config = NULL, 
                               rvest_options = list(), 
                               ...) {
  
  # Input validation
  if (!is.character(x) || length(x) == 0) {
    stop("x must be a character vector of URLs")
  }
  
  # Set default verbose if not provided
  if (is.null(verbose)) {
    verbose <- FALSE
  }
  
  # Set default httr_config if none provided
  if (is.null(httr_config)) {
    httr_config <- httr::config()
  }
  
  # Collect pages with custom configuration
  pages <- data.frame(
    url = x,
    expanded_url = x,
    domain = step_3_extract_domain(x),
    status = NA_integer_,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  
  # Add content_raw as list column
  pages$content_raw <- vector("list", nrow(pages))
  
  if (verbose) pb <- cli::cli_progress_bar("Collecting URLs:", total = nrow(pages))
  
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(pages))) {
    tryCatch({
      response <- httr::GET(pages$url[i], httr_config)
      pages$status[i] <- httr::status_code(response)
      pages$expanded_url[i] <- response$url
      
      if (pages$status[i] == 200) {
        # Store as parsed HTML document (xml_document)
        pages$content_raw[[i]] <- httr::content(response, type = "text/html", encoding = "UTF-8")
      }
    }, error = function(e) {
      pages$status[i] <- 0
      if (verbose) cli::cli_alert_warning("Failed to collect: {pages$url[i]} - {e$message}")
    })
    
    if (verbose) cli::cli_progress_update(id = pb)
  }
  
  if (verbose) cli::cli_progress_done()
  
  # Filter by status
  bad_status <- !pages$status %in% 200L | is.na(pages$status)
  pages <- pages[!bad_status, ]
  
  if (verbose && sum(bad_status, na.rm = TRUE) > 0) {
    cli::cli_alert_warning("{sum(bad_status, na.rm = TRUE)} URL{?s} removed due to bad status.")
  }
  
  # Check available parsers if needed
  if (!try_default && exists("pb_available")) {
    sel <- pb_available(pages$domain)
    pages <- pages[sel, ]
    if (verbose && sum(!sel) > 0) {
      cli::cli_alert_warning("{sum(!sel)} URL{?s} removed as no parser is available.")
    }
  }
  
  # Add classification
  if(exists("classify")) {
    pages$class <- classify(pages$domain)
  } else {
    # Simple classification based on domain
    pages$class <- gsub("\\.", "_", pages$domain)
  }
  
  pages <- dplyr::arrange(pages, domain)
  
  # Progress bar for parsing
  pb <- NULL
  if (verbose) {
    pb <- cli::cli_progress_bar("Parsing raw html:", total = nrow(pages))
  }
  
  # Parse each page
  results <- list()
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(pages))) {
    page <- pages[i, ]
    
    # Create object for parser
    page_obj <- list(
      url = page$url,
      expanded_url = page$expanded_url,
      domain = page$domain,
      status = page$status,
      content_raw = page$content_raw
    )
    class(page_obj) <- page$class
    
    # Try to parse
    parse_result <- tryCatch({
      pb_deliver_paper(page_obj, verbose = verbose, pb = pb)
    }, error = function(e) {
      if (!ignore_fails) stop(e)
      if (verbose) cli::cli_alert_danger("Parse error for {page$url}")
      data.frame(datetime = NA, author = NA, headline = NA, text = NA, misc = NA)
    })
    
    # Add paywall check
    paywall_flag <- step_2_check_paywall_func(page$domain, page$content_raw)
    
    # Combine results
    results[[i]] <- dplyr::bind_cols(
      page[c("url", "expanded_url", "domain", "status")],
      parse_result,
      data.frame(paywall_flag = paywall_flag)
    )
  }
  
  # Combine all results
  out <- do.call(rbind, results)
  
  if (verbose) {
    cli::cli_progress_done()
  }
  
  return(out)
}

cat("Step 3 completed: pb_deliver_advanced function created with flexible httr_config and rvest_options.\n")

## Step 4: Extract domain-specific parsing rules

# Get all deliver files
step_4_deliver_files <- list.files(file.path(step_3_temp_dir, "R"), 
                                   pattern = "^deliver_.*\\.R$", 
                                   full.names = TRUE)

# Get unique domains from link list
step_4_unique_domains <- unique(step_3_extract_domain(step_1_link_list$url))

# Initialize dataframe to store parsing rules
step_4_parsing_rules_df <- data.frame(
  domain = character(),
  parser_available = logical(),
  datetime_selector = character(),
  author_selector = character(),
  headline_selector = character(),
  text_selector = character(),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

# Extract domain from filename
step_4_filename_to_domain <- function(filename) {
  base <- basename(filename)
  domain_part <- gsub("^deliver_", "", gsub("\\.R$", "", base))
  domain <- gsub("_", ".", domain_part)
  return(domain)
}

# Extract selectors from file content
step_4_extract_selectors <- function(file_content, field) {
  # Look for html_search patterns
  pattern <- paste0(field, "\\s*<-.*html_search\\([^)]+\\)")
  matches <- grep(pattern, file_content, value = TRUE)
  
  if (length(matches) == 0) {
    # Try alternate patterns
    pattern <- paste0(field, "\\s*=.*html_search\\([^)]+\\)")
    matches <- grep(pattern, file_content, value = TRUE)
  }
  
  if (length(matches) > 0) {
    # Extract selector part
    selector_match <- regmatches(matches[1], 
                                regexpr("selectors\\s*=\\s*c\\([^)]+\\)", matches[1]))
    if (length(selector_match) > 0) {
      selectors <- gsub("selectors\\s*=\\s*c\\(|\\)", "", selector_match)
      selectors <- gsub("[\"\']", "", selectors)
      return(trimws(selectors))
    }
  }
  return(NA)
}

# Process each domain
for (file in step_4_deliver_files) {
  domain <- step_4_filename_to_domain(file)
  
  if (domain %in% step_4_unique_domains) {
    file_content <- readLines(file)
    
    # Check if parser exists for this domain
    parser_exists <- any(grepl(paste0("pb_deliver_paper\\.", gsub("\\.", "_", domain)), file_content))
    
    # Extract selectors
    datetime_sel <- step_4_extract_selectors(file_content, "datetime")
    author_sel <- step_4_extract_selectors(file_content, "author")
    headline_sel <- step_4_extract_selectors(file_content, "headline|heading")
    text_sel <- step_4_extract_selectors(file_content, "text|body")
    
    # Add to dataframe
    step_4_parsing_rules_df <- rbind(step_4_parsing_rules_df,
                                     data.frame(
                                       domain = domain,
                                       parser_available = parser_exists,
                                       datetime_selector = ifelse(is.na(datetime_sel), "", datetime_sel),
                                       author_selector = ifelse(is.na(author_sel), "", author_sel),
                                       headline_selector = ifelse(is.na(headline_sel), "", headline_sel),
                                       text_selector = ifelse(is.na(text_sel), "", text_sel),
                                       stringsAsFactors = FALSE
                                     ))
  }
}

# Save parsing rules
write_csv(step_4_parsing_rules_df, 
          file.path(step_1_working_data_output_folder, "domain_parsing_rules.csv"))

# Summary statistics
step_4_domains_with_parsers <- sum(step_4_parsing_rules_df$parser_available)
step_4_total_domains <- nrow(step_4_parsing_rules_df)

cat(sprintf("Step 4 completed: Found parsers for %d out of %d domains in link list. Rules saved.\n",
            step_4_domains_with_parsers,
            step_4_total_domains))
```


```{r}
test_url <- "https://www.zeit.de/politik/ausland/2025-05/ukraine-lage-luftangriffe-drohnen-raketen-waffen-merz-selenskyj-woche"

# Create working httr config without problematic options
step_3_default_httr_config <- httr::add_headers(
  "User-Agent" = "Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/91.0.4472.124 Safari/537.36",
  "Accept" = "text/html,application/xhtml+xml,application/xml;q=0.9,*/*;q=0.8",
  "Accept-Language" = "de-DE,de;q=0.9,en;q=0.8",
  "Accept-Encoding" = "gzip, deflate"
)

# Add timeout separately
step_3_default_httr_config <- c(
  step_3_default_httr_config,
  httr::timeout(30)
)

# Test the fetch again
cat("Test 1: Fetching URL...\n")
response <- httr::GET(test_url, step_3_default_httr_config)
cat("Status code:", httr::status_code(response), "\n")

# If that works, test pb_deliver_advanced
if (httr::status_code(response) == 200) {
  cat("\nFetch successful! Testing pb_deliver_advanced...\n")
  
  test_result <- pb_deliver_advanced(
    test_url,
    verbose = TRUE,
    httr_config = step_3_default_httr_config,
    ignore_fails = TRUE
  )
  
  # Check results
  if (!is.null(test_result) && is.data.frame(test_result) && nrow(test_result) > 0) {
    cat("\n✓ Success!\n")
    print(test_result[, c("domain", "status", "headline", "author")])
    
    # Show text preview if available
    if (!is.na(test_result$text[1])) {
      cat("\nText preview:\n")
      cat(substr(test_result$text[1], 1, 300), "...\n")
    }
  }
}

# Alternative: Use minimal config
if (httr::status_code(response) != 200) {
  cat("\nTrying with minimal config...\n")
  response <- httr::GET(test_url)
  cat("Status code:", httr::status_code(response), "\n")
  
  if (httr::status_code(response) == 200) {
    test_result <- pb_deliver_advanced(
      test_url,
      verbose = TRUE,
      ignore_fails = TRUE
    )
  }
}
```
